parts.part: Successor publication on an existing PR branch
parts.cause: The linked PR lookup filtered on a successor base that was already the PR head branch. Lookup now uses the linked PR number and checks delivery fields separately.
parts.proof: Whole linked-PR suite passes; guarded decision-answer detector also passes on main. Existing tests exercise publication, restart, skip, retry and publish.

parts.part: Terminal review after the final budget fix
parts.cause: The final fix followed a null pass edge into completion; recovery restarted failed terminal rechecks, and automatic merge admission accepted unreviewed terminal fixes.
parts.behavior: One terminal recheck runs on the final fixed head. Pass completes; failure retains the findings in needs_decision across a new controller process. Retained completed and queued unreviewed terminal fixes are refused. Merge admission is revalidated under the mutation lease after the forge reads and before issuing a merge.

conditions.isolation: One explicit file at a time in a fresh process with private HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, TMPDIR and LLV_STATE_DIR. Viewer and runtime control URLs use a closed loopback port.
conditions.baselineMethod: For the complete importer sweep, restore all six changed source modules to the pinned main revision, retaining the same test inputs, command and isolation. Run each whole red head file on main.
conditions.nativeAcceptanceMethod: Detached captured main in the owned remote export; copy only named head test detectors, keeping every production module at the selected Git revision. Logs stay outside the checkout until all checks end.
conditions.originalSuccessorSuite: native-main-original-successor-suite runs the original main test file on a detached main checkout; the guarded-decision detector also passes on main.
conditions.diagnosticNormalization: For the testChildren.ts owned-child teardown guard only, map positive child PIDs by first appearance, retaining list multiplicity and alias relationships. Keep the guardian value, source location and every other diagnostic unchanged.
conditions.migrationDiagnosticNormalization: For the migration fixture HTTP 400 spawn-capability error, replace its private per-test state directory with its fixed action name. Preserve the MCP code, HTTP status, reason and action; no other capability error is normalized.
conditions.stdioDiagnosticNormalization: For capability errors under four verified stdio fixture prefixes, normalize the private allocation root and random directory suffix only. Preserve the full reason and status, fixture kind, state leaf, punctuation and equal/distinct directory references within nested errors.
conditions.retryEnvelopeDiagnosticNormalization: For a pipeline_action STAGE_KIND_RETIRED error envelope whose text and structured projections agree, normalize only the random retry fixture id in both clientRequestId fields, retaining its attempt suffix and every other field.
conditions.failureAttribution: Use the final error header preceding each Bun fail marker and its following stack frames; earlier diagnostic logging is not attributed to the failing assertion.
conditions.forgeDiagnosticNormalization: For the verified forge-rename fixture only, normalize the private allocation directory in its EISDIR removal error; retain the operation, error code and project-remotes.json target.
conditions.testSeams: Terminal cases use the real controller and store with deterministic Git and agent ports. Restart cases execute a new Bun process. Linked-PR fixtures use real local Git and a simulated forge.
conditions.publicationSuite: The complete parked-publication child suite runs directly under a longer owned deadline; the earlier wrapper timeout is retained in the prior verification record.
